root-help.stdout:
usage: gossamer [-h] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR] [--config CONFIG]
                [--keystore KEYSTORE] [--log-level LOG_LEVEL]
                [--fetch-mode {auto,browser,static}]
                {search,research,categories,inspect,batch,download,locate-pdf,extract,check,discover,crawl,cache,cite,skills} ...

Web research toolkit (direct CLI)

positional arguments:
  {search,research,categories,inspect,batch,download,locate-pdf,extract,check,discover,crawl,cache,cite,skills}
    search              Web search (+ optional fetch)
    research            Domain-routed research (patents, law, finance, …)
    categories          List research categories + providers
    inspect             Fetch one page as markdown
    batch               Fetch several pages at once
    download            Download a remote file to a local path
    locate-pdf          Find OA PDF/landing-page candidates for a DOI
    extract             Extract a document (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/…) or feed
    check               Probe URL reachability
    discover            Find feeds + sitemap pages for a site
    crawl               Relevance-ranked link-graph traversal
    cache               Cache maintenance (prune/clear/reset)
    cite                Format DOIs/URLs as citations
    skills              Bundled agent skill packs (list/show/install)

options:

  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory (default: ./.gossamer_cache)
  --config CONFIG       Explicit gossamer.json path
  --keystore KEYSTORE   Explicit keys.json path
  --log-level LOG_LEVEL
                        DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR (default WARNING)
  --fetch-mode {auto,browser,static}
                        Baseline render strategy for page fetches: auto
                        (default), browser, or static (env GOSSAMER_FETCH_MODE

extract-help.stdout:
usage: gossamer extract [-h] [--pages PAGES] [--structured] [--store]
                        [--store-dir STORE_DIR] [--include-images]
                        [--tables-as {markdown,csv,json}] [--prefer-jats]
                        [--no-prefer-jats] [--cache-dir CACHE_DIR]
                        [--config CONFIG] [--keystore KEYSTORE]
                        [--log-level LOG_LEVEL]
                        [--fetch-mode {auto,browser,static}]
                        source

positional arguments:
  source                Local file path or remote URL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --pages PAGES         PDF page range, e.g. 10-20
  --structured          Structured payload (metadata/tables/links) where
                        supported
  --store               Write original + markdown under --store-dir
  --store-dir STORE_DIR
                        Directory for the stored original + extracted
                        markdown/resources (with --store)
  --include-images      PDF only, needs --store: also save figures
  --tables-as {markdown,csv,json}
                        Rendering of spreadsheet (XLSX) tables (default: json)
  --prefer-jats         JATS-first scholarly route (default on): DOI-
                        resolvable sources try publisher full-text XML
                        (EuropePMC, then PLOS) before the PDF path. pages=
                        with a JATS-resolvable source errors (sections, not
                        pages); --store writes <stem>.xml + <stem>.md;
                        --include-images is a no-op on the JATS route (remote
                        hrefs, not saved).
  --no-prefer-jats      Disable the JATS-first route; always use the PDF path
                        (also disables the pages=/JATS error)
  --cache-dir CACHE_DIR
                        Cache directory (default: ./.gossamer_cache)
  --config CONFIG       Explicit gossamer.json path
  --keystore KEYSTORE   Explicit keys.json path
  --log-level LOG_LEVEL
                        DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR (default WARNING)
  --fetch-mode {auto,browser,static}
                        Baseline render strategy for page fetches: auto
                        (default), browser, or static (env GOSSAMER_FETCH_MODE
                        / gossamer.json fetch_mode)
